site_description: Pulsedata Solutions builds all-in-one ERP software and digital infrastructure for enterprises in Addis Ababa: finance, HR, inventory, procurement, sales and production in one system.
home_hero_title: The missing piece of your operation.
home_hero_body: Pulsedata builds the system your business actually runs on: finance, people, stock, procurement and production in one place, on infrastructure light enough to run anywhere.
home_hero_note: Built on our own codebase. No heavy servers required.
home_modules_body: Every part of the business writes to the same data, so a sale, the stock it consumes and the invoice it raises are one event rather than three spreadsheets that disagree by Friday.
module_finance_body: Ledgers, receivables, payables and statements that close on time because nothing is entered twice.
module_hr_body: Contracts, attendance and payroll runs that hold up for a workforce of hundreds across several sites.
module_inventory_body: Stock levels, transfers and store issues tracked per branch, in real time.
module_procurement_body: Requests, quotations, purchase orders and goods receipts, each approved by the right person.
module_sales_body: Quotes, orders, invoices and the full history of every client relationship.
module_production_body: Work orders, materials consumed and output recorded on the floor as it happens.
module_costing_body: What a job was quoted, what it consumed and what it actually earned.
module_dashboards_body: The numbers management asks for, ready before the meeting rather than after it.
module_approvals_body: Every threshold and sign-off encoded once, then applied without being chased.
home_deployment_body: The same software either way. What differs is where it runs and how you pay for it.
deployment_perpetual_body: Buy it once and it is yours, with lifelong support. Suits an organisation that would rather hold a capital asset than a monthly line item.
deployment_saas_body: We host, secure, back up and keep it current. You open a browser. Suits a team that would rather not run servers at all.
deployment_saas_4: Scales up and down with you
deployment_footnote: Both models are customisable. Tell us how you operate and we will shape the fit.
service_implementation_body: Design, deployment and configuration of the modules your operation actually uses, not a generic install you are left to interpret.
service_licensing_body: Perpetual or subscription, on your servers or ours, with the migration planned rather than improvised.
service_web_body: Company websites, branded portals and the custom automated tools that sit around the ERP.
service_support_body: 24/7 technical assistance, staff training on every new feature, continuous security updates and routine backups.
home_industries_body: The harder your business is to hold in one head, the more this pays for itself.
home_work_body: A single deployment says more than a page of claims. Here is ours.
home_insights_title: What we have been thinking about.
home_insights_body: Notes on ERP, operations and building software that lasts.
home_cta_title: Let us show you what it looks like on your numbers.
home_cta_body: A live demo takes under an hour and uses your own processes, not a sample company. Bring the workflow that frustrates you most.
about_title: We build the system underneath the business.
about_intro: Pulsedata Solutions was founded in 2025 in Addis Ababa to give local enterprises the kind of digital infrastructure that until now meant importing a foreign platform and bending the business to fit it.
about_mission_body: To serve as the missing piece of the puzzle for modern enterprises, ensuring that businesses running our software operate with maximum efficiency, seamless daily workflows and zero friction.
about_vision_body: To become one of the leading ERP solutions providers in Addis Ababa, empowering local businesses with world-class digital infrastructure.
about_technical_body: Pulsedata is built from the ground up on a proprietary, custom-designed codebase rather than assembled from someone else's framework. That decision is why the system runs on modest hardware: it demands little to no heavy server or technical resource to hold peak performance, which in practice means a mid-range machine and a normal connection are enough to run a company on.
about_technical_point_1: Engineered for efficiency, not for a hardware budget.
about_technical_point_2: Every module written to fit the others, because we wrote them all.
about_technical_point_3: Changes we can actually make, since nothing is locked behind a vendor.
about_why_body: Every model we offer can be customised further to meet your exact needs. We would be glad to schedule a follow-up meeting or a live demo and walk through it against your own operation.
about_why_1_body: The suite is modular. You take the modules your operation needs and add the rest when you need them.
about_why_2_body: No heavy server requirement, which keeps the total cost far below what an enterprise system usually implies.
about_why_3_body: We are in Addis Ababa. Support is a call away and training happens in the room with your staff.
about_why_4_body: The ERP, the website, the portals and the automated tools around them: one team, one accountable delivery.
projects_intro: Every engagement here is live software running a real operation. Each page sets out what the business needed, what we built and what changed.
projects_empty: The first case studies are being written up. In the meantime, we would be glad to walk you through our work directly.
filter_no_results: Nothing matches that. Try a shorter search, or clear the filters.
projects_cta_title: Your operation could be the next one.
projects_cta_body: Tell us what is slowing you down and we will show you how it looks solved.
blogs_title: Notes on building systems that last.
blogs_intro: What we have learned deploying ERP in real operations, written for the people who have to run them.
blogs_empty: The first articles are on their way. Check back shortly.
contact_title: Tell us what you are trying to fix.
contact_intro: Whether you know exactly which modules you need or only that the current way is not working, start here. We reply within one business day.
contact_form_description: The more you tell us about how you operate, the more useful our first reply will be.
contact_field_phone_hint: Optional, but it is the fastest way to reach you.
contact_field_message_placeholder: Tell us about your operation: how many branches, how many staff, and what is costing you the most time right now.
contact_field_attachment_placeholder: Drop a requirements document or RFP here
contact_field_attachment_hint: Optional. PDF, Word, Excel or text, up to {mb} MB.
contact_success_body: Thank you. We have your message and will reply within one business day.
contact_error_body: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again, or email us directly.
contact_response_note: We reply to every enquiry within one business day.
validation_name_too_long: That name is longer than we can store.
validation_email_required: We need an email address to reply to.
validation_email_invalid: That does not look like an email address.
validation_phone_invalid: That does not look like a phone number.
validation_message_required: Please tell us what you need.
validation_message_too_short: A sentence or two would help us reply usefully.
validation_message_too_long: That message is longer than the form accepts.
validation_file_too_large: That file is larger than {mb} MB.
validation_file_type: That file type is not accepted.
newsletter_body: New articles and product news, a few times a year.
newsletter_success: You are on the list. Thank you.
error_404_body: The link may be out of date, or the page may have moved.
error_500_body: We have logged it. Please try again in a moment.
translation_pending: This has not been translated yet and is shown in English.
hero_effect_inventory: 120 bags released from the Bole store
hero_diagram_caption: One entry. Five ledgers. Nothing typed twice.
hero_diagram_hint: Select a ledger to see what it reads.
hero_diagram_label: A single sale, and the five parts of the business it writes to
login_subtitle: The dashboard is for Pulsedata staff.
login_failed: That email and password do not match an account.
dash_delete_confirm_body: This cannot be undone. The page will stop resolving for anyone who has its link.
dash_empty_projects: No projects yet. The first one you add appears on the site immediately if you publish it.
dash_empty_enquiries: No enquiries yet. They arrive here when someone sends the contact form.
dash_lang_hint: Both languages are optional except English. A field left empty in Amharic falls back to the English text.
dash_field_slug_hint: The address this appears at. Shared by both languages. Lower case, words separated by hyphens.
dash_field_featured_hint: Featured items lead their index page.
dash_field_published_at_hint: Leave in the future to schedule. A published item with no date appears immediately.
dash_field_cover_alt_hint: What the image shows, for readers using a screen reader.
dash_field_excerpt_hint: One or two sentences. Used on the index card and in search results.
dash_field_reading_hint: Leave empty and it is estimated from the body.
dash_field_website_hint: A link to the live site, if there is one to show.
dash_field_sort_hint: Lower numbers come first on the index.
dash_services_hint: Shown as chips on the case study.
dash_outcomes_hint: A figure and what it describes. Write the figure as it should read: "40%", "6 branches", "24/7".
dash_gallery_hint: Images shown below the case study.
dash_enquiry_language_note: Written in Amharic. Reply in Amharic.
dash_scheduled_note: Saved as published, but dated in the future: it appears on the site on that date, not now.
email_thanks_subject: We've received your message · Pulsedata Solutions
email_thanks_preheader: We have your message and will reply within one working day.
email_thanks_p1: Your message has reached us. Someone from our team will read it properly and reply to you personally within one working day.
email_thanks_p2: If anything changes in the meantime, just reply to this email; it comes straight back to the same conversation.
email_thanks_note: If you did not send this message, you can safely ignore this email; no action is needed.
email_enquiry_preheader: {name} sent a message through the website contact form.
email_enquiry_p1: A message arrived through the contact form on the website.
email_enquiry_note: Reply to this email to answer them directly, or open the enquiry in the dashboard to write from there.
email_enquiry_amharic: This enquiry was written in Amharic. Reply in Amharic.
dash_compose_intro: Goes out from the company address in the same template as every other email the site sends.
dash_email_failed: The message could not be sent. Nothing was delivered.
dash_reply_hint: Sent from the company address. Their answer comes back to that inbox, and this enquiry is marked replied.
dash_reply_open_client: Open in my mail app instead
dash_mail_off: Email is not configured on this server, so nothing can be sent yet. Set SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASSWORD in the environment.
error_contact_cta: Tell us what you were looking for
error_403_title: You do not have access to that.
error_403_body: Sign in with an account that does, or go back to the dashboard.
error_admin_body: The page could not be loaded. Try again, and if it keeps happening the server log will say why.
login_throttled: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
dash_gallery_intro: Images shown on the case study page, in this order. Each is an upload; replacing one here replaces it on the site.
dash_gallery_alt_hint: What the image shows, for readers using a screen reader.
dash_gallery_caption_hint: Printed under the image. Alt text describes; a caption comments.
dash_gallery_delete_body: The file is deleted as well as the row. This cannot be undone.
dash_gallery_save_first: Save the project once before adding images to it.
dash_gallery_upload_failed: That image could not be saved.
dash_empty_team: Nobody has been added yet. The about page hides the team section until someone is published.
dash_photos_on: Everyone published has a photograph, so the about page is showing portraits.
dash_photos_off: Portraits are hidden until every published member has a photograph; the about page shows initials instead.
dash_field_role_hint: The title shown under the name, such as “Head Developer”.
dash_field_bio_hint: Two or three sentences. It sits under the role on the about page.
dash_field_photo_hint: Portraits appear on the about page only once every published member has one.
dash_field_photo_alt_hint: For screen readers. Left empty, the person’s name is used.
dash_socials_hint: Shown as icons under the biography. Paste the full address; for email, just the address.
dash_company_socials_intro: The company's own accounts. They appear as icons in the site footer, in this order; leave the list empty and the footer shows none.
dash_company_socials_hint: Paste the full address, including https://. For email, just the address. Drop a row's address to remove it.
dash_traffic_note: Counted on the server. No cookies, no third party, no IP addresses stored.
dash_traffic_no_referrers: Nobody has arrived from another site yet.
dash_uptime_hint: Point an uptime monitor at this address; it answers 503 if the database is unreachable.
dash_mail_sent_intro: Every message this site has sent, including the ones that failed. Webmail's Sent folder does not show these; it only records what was sent from webmail itself.
dash_mail_failed_count: {n} of these never left the server. Open one to see what the mail server said.
dash_mail_failed_unknown: The mail server gave no reason.
dash_mail_search: Search by address, subject or sender
dash_mail_delete_body: The message itself was delivered long ago and is not affected. Only this record of it is removed, and that cannot be undone.
dash_empty_testimonials: No testimonials yet. The home page hides the section until one is published.
dash_empty_clients: No client logos yet. Add one and it appears in the band on the home page.
dash_clients_intro: The logos in the “trusted by” band on the home page. A client only appears there once it is published — keep it a draft until you have written permission to show the mark.
dash_field_client_name_hint: The company's name, as they write it. Used as the logo's alt text when you leave that blank.
dash_field_client_note_hint: One line, shown when someone hovers over the logo — a sector, or since when. Optional.
dash_field_client_site_hint: Optional. The logo links here when there is no case study to link to instead.
dash_field_client_project_hint: When set, the logo links to this case study rather than to the client's own site.
dash_field_client_logo_hint: Required. A PNG with a transparent background and a little room around the mark. SVG is not accepted — it can carry scripts — and the image is converted to WebP on the way in. It is shown on a white tile, so a logo drawn for a light background is the right one.
dash_client_logo_required: A client needs a logo — that is what the band shows.
dash_field_quote_photo_hint: The person who gave the quote. Shown as a small circle beside their name, so a square image crops best. Optional — their initials stand in.
dash_testimonials_intro: Quotes from clients, shown on the home page in this order. Publish at least two: a single quote reads as the only one anybody gave.
dash_field_quote_hint: Their words, without quotation marks; the page draws those.
dash_field_quote_role_hint: The title shown under the name, such as “Finance Manager”.
dash_field_company_hint: Printed beside the name, and used as the logo’s description when that is left empty.
dash_field_logo_hint: Optional. A transparent PNG or WEBP reads best. SVG is not accepted: it can carry script, so uploads refuse it.
dash_field_logo_alt_hint: For screen readers. Left empty, the company name is used.
home_testimonials_body: The people who run the books, the stores and the payroll on it, in their own words.
dash_field_project_hint: Links the quote to a case study, where it is shown beside the story. Optional: an unlinked quote still appears on the home page.
dash_project_gone: That case study no longer exists. Choose another, or leave the quote unlinked.
